engine.label: Kokoro v1.0 Core ML (FluidAudio legacy) · af_heart
engine.provider: coreml: FluidAudio legacy per stage compute policies
engine.streaming: resident Swift worker, one synthesizeDetailed call per segment, framed PCM over stdio: segment waveforms, not incremental within a segment; full mode is one synthesizeDetailed call
engine.chunkPolicy: planSegments: first chunk is the first clause or 4 words of sentence 1, then whole sentences, all submitted at once; trimSilence trims each chunk and appends a 150 ms gap
engine.cancellation: between segments in the worker (no stop request yet); an active Core ML chain runs to completion

loadDetail.note: loadMs is worker spawn plus KokoroAneManager.initialize (Core ML loads of compiled models, G2P assets, voice pack)
